name: spotify-recently-played
description: Embeddable Spotify recently-played widget for GitHub profile READMEs, served as SVG from a Cloudflare Worker.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your Spotify app. The token exchange happens in the Worker, so this never reaches a browser. (The **client ID** is not a secret - set it as a var in `wrangler.jsonc`.)

STATE_SECRET.description: Random string used to sign the OAuth `state` parameter. `openssl rand -base64 32`.

TOKEN_ENC_KEY.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes, used to encrypt stored refresh tokens. `openssl rand -base64 32`. **Back this up** - it cannot be regenerated.

FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY_B64.description: Base64 of the service account's PEM private key.

FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Firebase project ID. An identifier, not a credential - kept out of the repo only because the repo is public.

FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL.description: Service account client email. Useless without the private key; unpublished rather than sensitive.

FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL.description: Realtime Database URL, e.g. `https://project-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com`. Not a secret - the database is locked by rules, not by the URL being unguessable.

author: JeffreyCA
